claim_text: The September 13, 2022 Farah superseding indictment, No. 0:22-cr-00124 (ECF 57) para 17, recites that Sponsor A (unnamed on the face) went from receiving and disbursing approximately $5.6 million in federal funds to sites under its sponsorship in 2019 to more than $200 million in 2021. This is a Sponsor A network recital (amount_paid), not the Empire $40 million alleged_loss and not the Feeding Our Future $200 million recital. Do not add it to FOF $200 million, Bock $250 million, Empire $40 million, HSS, or Mohamed $12 million. This instrument does not identify Sponsor A by legal name.
